_readme: Subject lines for tools/images.py. Keyed <question id>-<a|b>. These describe WHAT is in the picture only. The single fixed art direction (palette, linework, no text, no logos) lives in STYLE in images.py and is appended to every one of these, which is what makes the set read as one collection. A question with no hint here falls back to its own option label as the subject, so hints are a refinement and never a requirement.
